summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) with the eleven members and an Enum import; botocore/args.py imports it as EPRBuiltins, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint config, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with 26 tests covering each behavioral criterion and exactly one custom-data and one bundled-data SDK endpoint test. The args, client, and regions unit tests pass (415 passed) with the prepared venv. Nothing is committed. Notes: FIPS and DualStack use the bridge's private lookups (_resolve_endpoint_variant_config_var and _resolve_use_dualstack_endpoint) because the bridge has no public ones. One pre-existing 82-column line in args.py (the InvalidS3UsEast1RegionalEndpointConfigError raise) was left untouched.
